Notes: THE HEAD COACH EXPLAINS A SCREEN (round AN, your note). One row = one box. SCREEN: base, brewery, shop or bounty (the Adventure board). REQUIRES: the usual condition language; a row that has played sets flag:guide_done_<ID>, so the next row can wait for it. SCENE: a Dialogue.csv scene shown in a box over the screen. HIGHLIGHT: the words on the button to light up after the box (it pulses until pressed; nothing is forced). THEN: what happens after the box, in the Progression.csv Do language - goto:base closes a window over the base. ONCE: true = only ever once. This row: the first brew - the Steeping Tank lights up (a machine is found by its name).
After the first brew: you are short of ingredients for a proper beer, so off on an Adventure. Sets flag:intro_adventure and takes you back to the base.
At the base, the Head Coach says go on an Adventure, and the Adventure banner lights up (not forced). The board then gives you only your first team - MatchModes.csv intro_adventure.
The Traveling Merchant introduces himself. He trades beer for what you carried home: data/Shop.csv rows priced in Reed and Bog Iron (Currencies.csv). This is where the intro stops for now.

ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL BREWERY (Anthony, 8 Oct). The cycle 2 round 2 TIME OUT: MatchTalk.csv Do brewery:tut_brewery opens the Brewery over the frozen match with flag:tut_brewery set. Hanna explains the brewers; THEN hands over the two machines and their keys (the tutorial's own save, wiped at the end); the Steeping Tank lights up. ONLY = true (new column): nothing but the lit machine can be clicked, and its mini-game cannot be lost (a miss starts it again).
Anthony: just the first and the last machine. Hanna skips the middle four and hands over a barrel; the Bottling Machine lights up.

Six Small Bottles in the bag (BottleSizes.csv; in the tutorial only the small bottle is offered). goto:back (new) closes the Brewery and the match carries on; the Tutorial's own MatchTalk.csv lines take it from there.

ROUND AN - "THE MORNING AFTER" (the Tutorial after the match, tutorial_morning.gd). The base in the tutorial save: the Head Coach takes you to the Dorms. All the tut-morning lines are drafts in data/TutorialMorningDialogue.csv.
The Dorms: rounds = power, rest = power, power 0 never needs a bed, a fixture wakes everybody a step, the drunk meter wears off.
Back at the base: the Brewery is dry, the Adventure Team, and the Head Coach leaves for Beuterdorf. The Adventure banner lights up.
The Bounty Board: Koch says which bounty (Bounties.csv tut_brewers_errand).
Home from the run, however it ended: Koch takes you back to the Dorms.
The Dorms again: the party in bed, the match side a fixture nearer fit. tutorial:end finishes the Tutorial (your own base, the starting team).

ROUND AN (Anthony, 10 Oct, look A): THE DORMS EXPLAINED, the first time you open them - the screen itself only says which room and how many are asleep. The lines are in data/DormsDialogue.csv. After the Tutorial rows above, so the morning after keeps its own Dorms lines.
